name: Getting Rid Of Friends
overview: Scripture calls believers to overcome evil with good and to live in obedience to God, resisting the devil so that he will flee. When faced with relationships that lead to sin or compromise faith, such as friendships that draw us away from truth, the believer must submit to God’s authority and make difficult decisions to protect their spiritual walk. The warning that there is no sacrifice for willful sin after knowing the truth underscores the seriousness of maintaining purity in our associations.
